extDescription.message: Send browser downloads and media to the Peregrine download manager on your computer.

noLinks.message: Peregrine: no downloadable links were found on this page.

appUnavailable.message: Peregrine is not running and could not be started.

statusNotInstalled.message: Peregrine app not found. Install it to capture downloads.

skipNextHint.message: Let the browser handle the next download once.

mediaEmpty.message: No media detected yet. Play the video or audio, then reopen this menu.

optMinSizeHint.message: Files at least this big are captured even if their type is not listed. Leave empty to use the app setting ($SIZE$).

optExtensionsHint.message: Separated by spaces or commas, for example: zip exe mp4

optExcludedHint.message: One site per line, for example: example.com (also covers its subdomains).

bypassNote.message: Tip: to let the browser handle one download, open the Peregrine menu and turn on “Skip next download”. (Holding a key while clicking cannot be detected by extensions.)

privacyNote.message: Download details are sent only to the Peregrine app on this computer. Nothing is sent to the internet.

pageVideo.message: Download the video on this page
